name: What is the process for removing black spots from walls?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for removing black spots from walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: The professional mold removal process typically begins with inspection and assessment to determine the extent of the growth and its source. Next, containment measures are put in place to prevent mold spores from spreading. Affected materials are then carefully removed and disposed of. The area is thoroughly cleaned, disinfected, and dried using specialized equipment. Finally, HEPA air filtration is often used to ensure air quality, and preventative measures are recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional mold removal involves inspection, containment, removal of contaminated materials, thorough cleaning, drying, and air filtration to prevent recurrence.
